html:
SMTO-MAN-0012 — The Agent's Manual lookup used options SMTO doesn't support

GUID: 0b8183ec-c0e9-56c4-84d2-18f4ee2d5173
Slug: docs-invalid-arguments
Domain: MAN · Subsystem: docs

What happened

  • While working on your request, the Agent tried to look something up in the SMTO Manual, but asked for options the Manual doesn't support. The lookup didn't run, and nothing was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Send your question again in fewer words and name the topic you want, for example "How do I add a Gateway?". The Agent builds its Manual search from your words, and a short, focused question makes a valid search far more likely.
  2. Open Manual from the navigation menu and type your topic into the Search manual box. Searching the Manual yourself skips the Agent's lookup, so the rejected options don't matter.
  3. If the Agent fails the same way again, select Copy error details on the error. The details show which Manual lookup options the Agent sent, which is what needs correcting.

What success looks like

  • The Agent's Manual step shows as completed and its answer refers to a Manual page, or your own search lists matching pages.

If it still fails

  • Send the copied error details and the question you asked to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep resending the same question quickly; the lookup will be rejected the same way each time.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Docs skill rejected a Manual search, fetch or list call because its arguments failed schema or range checks (unknown scope or kind, more than 12 tags, a query not 1-256 characters long, a search limit outside 1-12, a list limit outside 1-50, or max_characters outside 1000-20000).

What this means

  • Docs schema/filter/search/fetch/list validation rejects unsupported fields, scope/kind, query length, retrieval bounds or option types. Manual lookup diagnostics describe local snapshot availability and validation. They neither fetch external documentation nor rebuild content during rendering; generated-lane failure does not invalidate an available authored corpus.

Why this can happen

  • Docs schema/filter/search/fetch/list validation rejects unsupported fields, scope/kind, query length, retrieval bounds or option types.

How to diagnose it

  • Identify the rejected operation field and compare it with that operation's current schema.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the Docs tool call in the Run's trace and correct its arguments to the declared schema: scope current/authored/generated/historical/all, kind manual/architecture/guide/generated/legacy, at most 12 tags of 1-80 characters, and the documented limit and max_characters ranges. The Manual content is unaffected; do not retry identical arguments in a tight loop.
  • Use the declared Docs schema and supported scope, kind and bounds.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use the declared Docs schema and supported scope, kind and bounds.

How to verify the fix

  • The bounded request validates and returns results in the intended Manual scope.

What not to do

  • Do not invent references, read arbitrary files through Docs or retry in a tight loop.

Technical notes

  • Manual lookup diagnostics describe local snapshot availability and validation. They neither fetch external documentation nor rebuild content during rendering; generated-lane failure does not invalidate an available authored corpus.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
